question: Does this status indicate that normal trade execution is unavailable during some portion of the outcome horizon?
derivation: Classified from the Alpaca trading-status documentation (source) and the CTA/UTP halt conventions. Never from trade gaps or outcomes.
reconstruction: HALT/PAUSE/NON_TRADABLE opens an interruption; RESUME ends it; INFORMATIONAL changes nothing; an unlisted code or unknown tape opens an unclassified interval ended only by a classified interruption or RESUME. A reach before the interruption starts is a success; otherwise the outcome is censored.

2.why: Execution unavailable. CTA LULD pauses (reason M) and market-wide circuit breakers (reasons 1-3) arrive as this code too.

5.why: Indication published during a halt or delayed open. It does not end the halt.

E.why: Rule 201 restricts short-sale prices; execution remains available.

F.why: LULD band/limit-state information. A LULD trading pause is disseminated as 2 with reason M, so this code is not itself a pause. DECISION ITEM.

H.why: Execution unavailable (news, regulatory, SEC, MWCB and other halt reasons).

Q.why: Quote-only period: quoting resumes before trading does, so trading is still unavailable.
